nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of contract owner, set to msg.sender in constructor and changed by transferOwnership.
SafeERC20Timelock.balance: mapping(address => mapping(uint => uint)) of locked amounts per beneficiary and unlock timestamp.
SafeERC20Timelock.token: IERC20 instance whose tokens are timelocked.
SafeERC20Timelock.totalBalance: accounting sum of all locked tokens.
Caller-controlled address, used for ownership, token source and beneficiary resolution.
Miner-influenceable current time source returned by getTimestamp_().
accept(address _for, uint _timestamp, uint _tvalue): public entry that pulls tokens via transferFrom and records a lock.
release_(address _for, uint[] _timestamp, uint[] _value): internal unlock loop that updates balances then transfers tokens out.
release(uint[] _timestamp, uint[] _value): external wrapper releasing to msg.sender.
releaseForce(address _for, uint[] _timestamp, uint[] _value): external wrapper releasing on behalf of any address.
saveLockedERC20Tokens(address _token, address _to, uint _amount): onlyOwner arbitrary token sweep from the timelock.
transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner ownership transfer.
contractBalance_(): internal view returning token.balanceOf(this).
TimeMachineP.getTimestamp_(): internal view returning block.timestamp (time-machine override point).
Fallback function: payable, unconditionally reverts.
constructor(address _token): links the ERC20 token instance to the timelock.
SafeMath.add: overflow-checked addition used for lock accounting.
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction used for lock accounting.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication (defined, unused in the timelock).
SafeMath.div: division with zero check (defined, unused in the timelock).
SafeMath.mod: modulo with zero check (defined, unused in the timelock).
External call token.transferFrom(msg.sender, this, _tvalue) executed before lock state is written.
External call token.transfer(_for, _totalValue) performed inside the release loop flow.
External call IERC20(_token).transfer(_to, _amount) on an attacker-supplied token address.
require(_timestamp > getTimestamp_()) in accept: lock timestamp validated against block.timestamp.
require(_curTimestamp <= _now) in release_: unlock gate driven by block.timestamp.
Arithmetic accounting in accept: balance[_for][_timestamp] = _balance.add(_value) and totalBalance = _totalBalance.add(_value).
Arithmetic accounting in release_: _curValue.sub(_subValue), _totalValue.add(_subValue) and totalBalance.sub(_totalValue).

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller of accept and the source of tokens pulled into the timelock.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument to token.transferFrom.
release forwards msg.sender as the _for beneficiary to release_.
transferOwnership is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) in the onlyOwner modifier.
saveLockedERC20Tokens is guarded by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
getTimestamp_ returns block.timestamp, propagating miner-influenceable time into the contract.
accept requires _timestamp > getTimestamp_(), making lock validity timestamp dependent.
release_ uses _now = getTimestamp_() to authorize unlocking, a timestamp dependency.
accept performs the external token.transferFrom call.
The external token call executes before balance[_for][_timestamp] and totalBalance are updated, allowing re-entrant state reads.
accept performs the add-based balance and totalBalance accounting.
SafeMath.add is the arithmetic primitive used for the lock accounting in accept.
accept writes balance[_for][_timestamp] = _balance.add(_value).
accept increases totalBalance by the received value.
accept calls contractBalance_() before and after transferFrom to measure the received amount.
release delegates execution to release_(msg.sender, _timestamp, _value).
releaseForce delegates execution to release_(_for, _timestamp, _value).
release_ invokes the external token.transfer to pay out unlocked tokens.
External token.transfer inside release_ can re-enter before totalBalance bookkeeping completes.
release_ performs sub/add based accounting on balances and totalBalance.
SafeMath.sub and add are the arithmetic primitives used by release_.
release_ decrements balance[_for][_curTimestamp] by _subValue.
release_ decreases totalBalance by _totalValue.
saveLockedERC20Tokens performs an external transfer on a caller-supplied token address.
External call to an arbitrary token contract from a privileged function can re-enter the timelock.
saveLockedERC20Tokens checks totalBalance <= contractBalance_() after the sweep.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
The constructor assigns the token state variable from _token.
contractBalance_ reads token.balanceOf(this) from the token state variable.
accept contains the timestamp comparison require(_timestamp > getTimestamp_()).
block.timestamp reaches the accept timestamp check through getTimestamp_.
release_ contains the timestamp comparison require(_curTimestamp <= _now).
block.timestamp gates unlocking inside release_ through _now.
